- email string (e.g. "test%2Babc%40gmail.com") - Email — URL-encoded. E.g. test+abc@gmail.com → test%2Babc%40gmail.com

Response 200: no body

### Lookup Contact By Email Or Phone
GET /contacts/lookup
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/contacts/lookup
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/contacts/lookup-contact | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/contacts/lookup-contact.md

Look up contacts matching an exact `email` or `phone`, scoped to a location, up to `limit` contacts (max 20) per page. Also matches against a contact's additional emails and additional phone numbers. Exactly one of `email` or `phone` must be provided. Paginate with `nextCursor`. Returns an empty `contacts` array if no contact matches. OAuth channel only.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: contacts.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location Id. Must be a non-empty string.
- email string (e.g. "abc@abc.com") - Exact email to look up (case-insensitive), mutually exclusive with `phone`.
- phone string (e.g. "+1423164516") - Exact phone number to look up, in E.164 format, mutually exclusive with `email`.
- nextCursor string (e.g. "eyJkYXRlQWRkZWQiOjE3MDAwMDAwMDAwMDAsImlkIjoiYy1sYXN0In0=") - Opaque pagination cursor returned as `nextCursor` by a previous request.
- limit integer (e.g. 20) - Max number of contacts to return per page. Defaults to 20, capped at 20.

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- contacts object[] - Contacts matching the given email or phone, up to the requested `limit` (max 20)
  - id string - Unique identifier of the contact
  - name string - Full name of the contact
  - locationId string - Location Id the contact belongs to
  - firstName string - First name of the contact
  - lastName string - Last name of the contact
  - email string - Email address of the contact
  - emailLowerCase string - Lowercase version of the contact email
  - timezone string - Timezone of the contact

### Update Contact
PUT /contacts/{contactId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/contacts/{contactId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/contacts/update-contact | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/contacts/update-contact.md

Update a contact using contactId

> ⚠️ **When updating additional emails/phones, always include the current primary `email`/`phone` in the same request. Otherwise, the existing primary value may be lost.**

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: contacts.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- contactId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Unique identifier of the contact

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateContactDtoV3:
- firstName string (nullable; e.g. "rosan") - First name of the contact
- lastName string (nullable; e.g. "Deo") - Last name of the contact
- name string (nullable; e.g. "rosan Deo") - Full name of the contact
- email string (nullable; e.g. "rosan@deos.com") - Email address of the contact
- phone string (nullable; e.g. "+1 888-888-8888") - Phone number of the contact
- address1 string (nullable; e.g. "3535 1st St N") - Street address of the contact
- city string (nullable; e.g. "Dolomite") - City of the contact
- state string (nullable; e.g. "AL") - State of the contact
- postalCode string (e.g. "35061") - Postal code of the contact
- website string (nullable; e.g. "https://www.tesla.com") - Website URL of the contact
- timezone string (nullable; e.g. "America/Chihuahua") - Timezone of the contact
- dnd boolean - Whether Do Not Disturb is enabled for the contact
- inboundDndSettings object - Inbound DND settings per channel for the contact
  - all object - Inbound DND settings applied to all channels
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive; e.g. "active") - Inbound DND status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Please do not contact me via this channel") - Custom message associated with the inbound DND setting
- tags string[] (e.g. ["nisi sint commodo amet","consequat"]) - This field will overwrite all current tags associated with the contact. To update a tags, it is recommended to use the Add Tag or Remove Tag API instead.
- customFields (object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object)[] - List of custom field values to assign to the contact
  - option 1 TextField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue string (e.g. "My Text") - Text value for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value string (deprecated; e.g. "My Text") - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 2 LargeTextField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue string (e.g. "My Text") - Large text value for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value string (deprecated; e.g. "My Text") - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 3 SingleSelectField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue string (e.g. "My Selected Option") - Selected option value for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value string (deprecated; e.g. "My Selected Option") - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 4 RadioField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue string (e.g. "My Selected Option") - Selected radio option value for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value string (deprecated; e.g. "My Selected Option") - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 5 NumericField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue object (e.g. 100) - Numeric value for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value object (deprecated; e.g. 100) - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 6 MonetoryField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue object (e.g. 100.5) - Monetary value for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value object (deprecated; e.g. 100.5) - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 7 CheckboxField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue string[] (e.g. ["test","test2"]) - Array of selected checkbox values for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value string[] (deprecated; e.g. ["test","test2"]) - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 8 MultiSelectField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue string[] (e.g. ["test","test2"]) - Array of selected values for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value string[] (deprecated; e.g. ["test","test2"]) - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 9 FileField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue object - File upload value — a map of UUID to file metadata and download URL (preferred).
    - field_value object (deprecated) - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
- source string (nullable; e.g. "public api") - Source from which the contact was updated
- dateOfBirth object (nullable; e.g. "1990-09-25") - The birth date of the contact. Supported formats: YYYY/MM/DD, MM/DD/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD, MM-DD-YYYY, YYYY.MM.DD, MM.DD.YYYY, YYYY_MM_DD, MM_DD_YYYY
- country string (e.g. "US") - Country code of the contact (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), Refer country list from documentaion, documentation has list of all countries
- assignedTo string (nullable; e.g. "y0BeYjuRIlDwsDcOHOJo") - User's Id
- additionalEmails object[] (maxItems: 10) - Add additional email addresses to a contact. > ⚠️ **Important:** When sending `additionalEmails`, you must also include the contact’s current primary `email` in the same request.<br>If you send `additionalEmails` without `email`, the contact’s existing primary email may be cleared or replaced. <ul style="list-style: disc; padding-left: 1.5rem"> <li style="list-style: disc"><code>email</code> represents the contact’s <strong>primary email address</strong>.</li> <li style="list-style: disc"><code>additionalEmails</code> represents secondary email addresses for the same contact.</li> <li style="list-style: disc">Always send the primary <code>email</code> together with <code>additionalEmails</code> when updating email addresses.</li> <li style="list-style: disc">A maximum of <strong>10 additional email addresses</strong> can be provided.</li> </ul> Example ```json { "email": "john@example.com", "additionalEmails": [ { "email": "john.work@example.com" } ] } ``` Avoid ```json { "additionalEmails": [ { "email": "john.work@example.com" } ] } ``` Sending only `additionalEmails` may cause the existing primary email to be lost. If email uniqueness is enabled for the location, every email address in the request—primary and additional—must be unique across contacts. If any email already belongs to another contact, the request fails with **400 Bad Request** and no changes are saved.
  - email* string (e.g. "rosan@deos.com") - Additional Email
- additionalPhones object[] (maxItems: 10) - Add additional phone numbers to a contact. > ⚠️ **Important:** When sending `additionalPhones`, you must also include the contact’s current primary `phone` in the same request.<br>If you send `additionalPhones` without `phone`, the contact’s existing primary phone may be cleared or replaced. <ul style="list-style: disc; padding-left: 1.5rem"> <li style="list-style: disc"><code>phone</code> represents the contact’s <strong>primary phone number</strong>.</li> <li style="list-style: disc"><code>additionalPhones</code> represents secondary phone numbers for the same contact.</li> <li style="list-style: disc">Always send the primary <code>phone</code> together with <code>additionalPhones</code> when updating phone numbers.</li> <li style="list-style: disc">A maximum of <strong>10 additional phone numbers</strong> can be provided.</li> <li style="list-style: disc"><code>phoneLabel</code> is optional. Allowed values: <code>Home</code>, <code>Work</code>, <code>Mobile</code>, or <code>Landline</code>. A label can belong to only one phone number on the contact, including the primary. If a label is repeated, it is kept on the first phone number and removed from the others.</li> </ul> Example ```json { "phone": "+14155550100", "additionalPhones": [ { "phone": "+14155550101", "phoneLabel": "Work" } ] } ``` Avoid ```json { "additionalPhones": [ { "phone": "+14155550101", "phoneLabel": "Work" } ] } ``` Sending only `additionalPhones` may cause the existing primary phone number to be lost. If phone uniqueness is enabled for the location, every phone number in the request—primary and additional—must be unique across contacts. If any phone number already belongs to another contact, the request fails with **400 Bad Request** and no changes are saved.
  - phone* string (e.g. "7017345098") - Additional Phones
  - phoneLabel string (enum: Home | Work | Mobile | Landline; e.g. "Mobile") - Label
- dndSettings object - Per-channel DND settings for the contact
  - call object - DND settings for phone calls
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent; e.g. "active") - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Do not contact via this channel") - Custom message associated with the DND setting
    - code string (e.g. "OPTED_OUT") - DND code or reason
  - email object - DND settings for email
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent; e.g. "active") - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Do not contact via this channel") - Custom message associated with the DND setting
    - code string (e.g. "OPTED_OUT") - DND code or reason
  - sms object - DND settings for SMS
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent; e.g. "active") - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Do not contact via this channel") - Custom message associated with the DND setting
    - code string (e.g. "OPTED_OUT") - DND code or reason
  - whatsApp object - DND settings for WhatsApp
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent; e.g. "active") - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Do not contact via this channel") - Custom message associated with the DND setting
    - code string (e.g. "OPTED_OUT") - DND code or reason
  - gmb object - DND settings for Google My Business
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent; e.g. "active") - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Do not contact via this channel") - Custom message associated with the DND setting
    - code string (e.g. "OPTED_OUT") - DND code or reason
  - fb object - DND settings for Facebook
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent; e.g. "active") - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Do not contact via this channel") - Custom message associated with the DND setting
    - code string (e.g. "OPTED_OUT") - DND code or reason

### Update Task
PUT /contacts/{contactId}/tasks/{taskId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/contacts/{contactId}/tasks/{taskId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/contacts/update-task | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/contacts/update-task.md

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: contacts.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- contactId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Contact Id
- taskId* string (e.g. "ocQHyuzHvysMo5N5VsXc") - Task Id

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateTaskBody:
- title string (e.g. "First Task") - Title of the task
- body string (e.g. "loram ipsum") - Body or description of the task
- dueDate string (e.g. "2020-10-25T11:00:00Z") - Due date of the task (ISO 8601 format)
- completed boolean - Whether the task is completed
- assignedTo string (e.g. "hxHGVRb1YJUscrCB8eXK") - User Id to whom the task is assigned

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- task object - Task details
  - id string - Unique identifier of the task
  - title string - Title of the task
  - body string - Body or description of the task
  - assignedTo string - User Id to whom the task is assigned
  - dueDate string - Due date of the task (ISO 8601 format)
  - completed boolean - Whether the task is completed
  - contactId string - Contact Id associated with the task

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Upsert Contact
POST /contacts/upsert
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/contacts/upsert
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/contacts/upsert-contact | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/contacts/upsert-contact.md

The Upsert API will adhere to the configuration defined under the "Allow Duplicate Contact" setting at the Location level. If the setting is configured to check both Email and Phone, the API will attempt to identify an existing contact based on the priority sequence specified in the setting, and will create or update the contact accordingly.<br/><br/>If two separate contacts already exist—one with the same email and another with the same phone—and an upsert request includes both the email and phone, the API will update the contact that matches the first field in the configured sequence, and ignore the second field to prevent duplication.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: contacts.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) UpsertContactDtoV3:
- firstName string (nullable; e.g. "Rosan") - First name of the contact
- lastName string (nullable; e.g. "Deo") - Last name of the contact
- name string (nullable; e.g. "Rosan Deo") - Full name of the contact
- email string (nullable; e.g. "rosan@deos.com") - Email address of the contact
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location Id the contact should be created under
- gender string (e.g. "male") - Gender of the contact
- phone string (nullable; e.g. "+1 888-888-8888") - Phone number of the contact
- address1 string (nullable; e.g. "3535 1st St N") - Street address of the contact
- city string (nullable; e.g. "Dolomite") - City of the contact
- state string (nullable; e.g. "AL") - State of the contact
- postalCode string (e.g. "35061") - Postal code of the contact
- website string (nullable; e.g. "https://www.tesla.com") - Website URL of the contact
- timezone string (nullable; e.g. "America/Chihuahua") - Timezone of the contact
- dnd boolean - Whether Do Not Disturb is enabled for the contact
- inboundDndSettings object - Inbound DND settings per channel for the contact
  - all object - Inbound DND settings applied to all channels
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive; e.g. "active") - Inbound DND status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Please do not contact me via this channel") - Custom message associated with the inbound DND setting
- tags string[] (e.g. ["nisi sint commodo amet","consequat"]) - This field will overwrite all current tags associated with the contact. To update a tags, it is recommended to use the Add Tag or Remove Tag API instead.
- customFields (object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object)[] - List of custom field values to assign to the contact
  - option 1 TextField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue string (e.g. "My Text") - Text value for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value string (deprecated; e.g. "My Text") - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 2 LargeTextField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue string (e.g. "My Text") - Large text value for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value string (deprecated; e.g. "My Text") - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 3 SingleSelectField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue string (e.g. "My Selected Option") - Selected option value for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value string (deprecated; e.g. "My Selected Option") - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 4 RadioField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue string (e.g. "My Selected Option") - Selected radio option value for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value string (deprecated; e.g. "My Selected Option") - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 5 NumericField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue object (e.g. 100) - Numeric value for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value object (deprecated; e.g. 100) - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 6 MonetoryField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue object (e.g. 100.5) - Monetary value for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value object (deprecated; e.g. 100.5) - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 7 CheckboxField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue string[] (e.g. ["test","test2"]) - Array of selected checkbox values for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value string[] (deprecated; e.g. ["test","test2"]) - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 8 MultiSelectField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue string[] (e.g. ["test","test2"]) - Array of selected values for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value string[] (deprecated; e.g. ["test","test2"]) - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 9 FileField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue object - File upload value — a map of UUID to file metadata and download URL (preferred).
    - field_value object (deprecated) - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
- source string (e.g. "public api") - Source from which the contact was created
- dateOfBirth object (nullable; e.g. "1990-09-25") - The birth date of the contact. Supported formats: YYYY/MM/DD, MM/DD/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD, MM-DD-YYYY, YYYY.MM.DD, MM.DD.YYYY, YYYY_MM_DD, MM_DD_YYYY
- country string (e.g. "US") - Country code of the contact (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)
- companyName string (nullable; e.g. "DGS VolMAX") - Company name of the contact
- assignedTo string (e.g. "y0BeYjuRIlDwsDcOHOJo") - User's Id
- createNewIfDuplicateAllowed boolean (default: false) - Controls whether to create a new contact or update an existing duplicate. **Scenario 1:** If this value is `true` and the location allows duplicate contacts, a new contact will be created immediately without checking for duplicates. **Scenario 2:** If this value is `true` but the location does not allow duplicate contacts, this field is ignored and the normal upsert behavior applies: the API will search for an existing duplicate contact, update it if found, or create a new contact if not found. **Scenario 3:** If this value is `false` or not provided, the normal upsert behavior applies regardless of the location's duplicate contact setting.
- dndSettings object - Per-channel DND settings for the contact
  - call object - DND settings for phone calls
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent; e.g. "active") - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Do not contact via this channel") - Custom message associated with the DND setting
    - code string (e.g. "OPTED_OUT") - DND code or reason
  - email object - DND settings for email
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent; e.g. "active") - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Do not contact via this channel") - Custom message associated with the DND setting
    - code string (e.g. "OPTED_OUT") - DND code or reason
  - sms object - DND settings for SMS
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent; e.g. "active") - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Do not contact via this channel") - Custom message associated with the DND setting
    - code string (e.g. "OPTED_OUT") - DND code or reason
  - whatsApp object - DND settings for WhatsApp
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent; e.g. "active") - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Do not contact via this channel") - Custom message associated with the DND setting
    - code string (e.g. "OPTED_OUT") - DND code or reason
  - gmb object - DND settings for Google My Business
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent; e.g. "active") - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Do not contact via this channel") - Custom message associated with the DND setting
    - code string (e.g. "OPTED_OUT") - DND code or reason
  - fb object - DND settings for Facebook
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent; e.g. "active") - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Do not contact via this channel") - Custom message associated with the DND setting
    - code string (e.g. "OPTED_OUT") - DND code or reason

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- new boolean - Whether a new contact was created (true) or an existing one was updated (false)
- contact object - Contact details
  - id string - Unique identifier of the contact
  - name string - Full name of the contact
  - locationId string - Location Id the contact belongs to
  - firstName string - First name of the contact
  - lastName string - Last name of the contact
  - email string - Email address of the contact
  - emailLowerCase string - Lowercase version of the contact email
  - timezone string - Timezone of the contact
  - companyName string - Company name of the contact
  - phone string - Phone number of the contact
  - dnd boolean - Whether Do Not Disturb is enabled for the contact
  - type string - Contact type classification
  - source string - Source from which the contact was created
  - assignedTo string - User Id the contact is assigned to
  - address1 string - Street address of the contact
  - city string - City of the contact
  - state string - State of the contact
  - country string - Country of the contact
  - postalCode string - Postal code of the contact
  - website string - Website URL of the contact
  - tags string[] - List of tags associated with the contact
  - dateOfBirth string - Date of birth of the contact (YYYY-MM-DD)
  - dateAdded string - Date and time the contact was added (ISO 8601)
  - dateUpdated string - Date and time the contact was last updated (ISO 8601)
  - attachments string - List of attachment URLs associated with the contact
  - ssn string - Social Security Number (if applicable)
  - keyword string - Search keyword associated with the contact
  - firstNameLowerCase string - Lowercase version of the contact first name
  - fullNameLowerCase string - Lowercase version of the contact full name
  - lastNameLowerCase string - Lowercase version of the contact last name
  - lastActivity string - Date and time of last activity on this contact (ISO 8601)
  - customFields object[] - List of custom field values for the contact
    - id string - Unique identifier of the custom field
    - value string - Value of the custom field
  - businessId string - Business Id the contact is associated with
  - attributionSource object - First-touch attribution source details for the contact
    - url* string - Attribution source type
    - campaign string (nullable) - Campaign name
    - utmSource string (nullable) - UTM source parameter
    - utmMedium string (nullable) - UTM medium parameter
    - utmContent string (nullable) - UTM content parameter
    - referrer string (nullable) - Referrer URL
    - campaignId string (nullable) - Campaign Id
    - fbclid string (nullable) - Facebook click Id
    - gclid string (nullable) - Google click Id
    - msclikid string (nullable) - Microsoft click Id
    - dclid string (nullable) - DoubleClick click Id
    - fbc string (nullable) - Facebook browser Id
    - fbp string (nullable) - Facebook pixel Id
    - fbEventId string (nullable) - Facebook event Id
    - userAgent string (nullable) - Browser user agent string
    - ip string (nullable) - IP address of the visitor
    - medium string (nullable) - Attribution medium (e.g. survey, funnel)
    - mediumId string (nullable) - Id of the attribution medium
  - lastAttributionSource object - Last-touch attribution source details for the contact
    - url* string - Attribution source type
    - campaign string (nullable) - Campaign name
    - utmSource string (nullable) - UTM source parameter
    - utmMedium string (nullable) - UTM medium parameter
    - utmContent string (nullable) - UTM content parameter
    - referrer string (nullable) - Referrer URL
    - campaignId string (nullable) - Campaign Id
    - fbclid string (nullable) - Facebook click Id
    - gclid string (nullable) - Google click Id
    - msclikid string (nullable) - Microsoft click Id
    - dclid string (nullable) - DoubleClick click Id
    - fbc string (nullable) - Facebook browser Id
    - fbp string (nullable) - Facebook pixel Id
    - fbEventId string (nullable) - Facebook event Id
    - userAgent string (nullable) - Browser user agent string
    - ip string (nullable) - IP address of the visitor
    - medium string (nullable) - Attribution medium (e.g. survey, funnel)
    - mediumId string (nullable) - Id of the attribution medium
  - additionalEmails object[] - Additional emails associated with the contact
    - email* string - Additional Email
  - additionalPhones object[] - Additional phone numbers associated with the contact
    - phone* string - Additional Phones
    - phoneLabel string (enum: Home | Work | Mobile | Landline) - Label
  - visitorId string - visitorId is the Unique ID assigned to each Live chat visitor.
  - dndSettings object - Per-channel DND settings for the contact
    - call object - DND settings for phone calls
      - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent) - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
      - message string - Custom message associated with the DND setting
      - code string - DND code or reason
    - email object - DND settings for email
      - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent) - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
      - message string - Custom message associated with the DND setting
      - code string - DND code or reason
    - sms object - DND settings for SMS
      - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent) - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
      - message string - Custom message associated with the DND setting
      - code string - DND code or reason
    - whatsApp object - DND settings for WhatsApp
      - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent) - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
      - message string - Custom message associated with the DND setting
      - code string - DND code or reason
    - gmb object - DND settings for Google My Business
      - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent) - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
      - message string - Custom message associated with the DND setting
      - code string - DND code or reason
    - fb object - DND settings for Facebook
      - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent) - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
      - message string - Custom message associated with the DND setting
      - code string - DND code or reason
- traceId string - Unique trace identifier for this operation

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
